context: Plugin 1.12.0: bundled server pin ^1.20.0 → ^2.0.0, superseding the quiet-week gate on Dave's field evidence of dual-server version skew. rationale: 2.0.0 is code-identical to beta.3 (11 days of soak), so the wait added no signal, while the dual-server version skew has demonstrated field cost (Dave hit it during beta; the deniedMcpServers avoidance is exact-command-match brittle) and worsens post-stable: a project migrated to format version 2 turns a 1.x plugin server read-only with broken hooks.
summary: Bumped the plugin server pin to ^2.0.0 now (plugin 1.12.0) instead of waiting the planned quiet week after stable — supersedes the stable-cut decision to leave both pins untouched.
